sharedRules.name: Harbingers of Dread
sharedRules.description:
At the start of the battle round, you can use this ability, if your Army Faction is CHAOS KNIGHTS, during the first battle round or during the third battle round or during the fifth battle round, for the rest of the battle:
  - At the start of the battle, Deathly Terror is active.
  - Select one (each can be chosen once per battle) (in addition to any already active):
    - Deathly Terror: While an enemy unit is within 9" of this model, worsen that unit's Leadership characteristic by 1.
    - Despair: While an enemy unit is within 9" of this model, worsen that unit's Leadership characteristic by 1.
    - Doom: While the target is Battle-shocked, add 1 to this model's Wound rolls.
    - Darkness: This model gains the Stealth ability.
    - Dismay: At the start of the Battle Shock step in your opponent's turn, for each enemy unit: while this unit is below its Starting Strength and this unit is within 9" of this model, that unit must take a Battle-shock test.
    - Delirium: When an enemy unit within 9" of this model fails a Battle-shock test, while an enemy unit is within 9" of this model, while this unit is Below Half-strength, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
    - Dominion: Increase the range of each AURA ability of this model by 3".
  - Or, instead of selecting, roll two D6: each result applies the option it numbers (1 Despair, 2 Doom, 3 Darkness, 4 Dismay, 5 Delirium, 6 Dominion); a result already active has no additional effect.

sharedRules.name: Super-heavy Walker
sharedRules.description:
When this model ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move:
  - The triggering unit can move over non-Titanic models as though they were not there.
  - The triggering unit can move over terrain features 4" or lower as though they were not there.
  - The triggering unit is eligible to move even if it is within Engagement Range of enemy units.
  - The triggering unit cannot end a move within Engagement Range of any enemy unit, during its Normal, Advance and Fall Back moves.
  - The triggering unit can move over terrain features over 4" as though they were not there.
When this model moves through terrain over 4" tall:
  - Roll one D6:
    - On 1: This unit is Battle-shocked.
    - On 2-6: Nothing happens.

sharedRules.name: Dreadblades
sharedRules.description:
If every model in your army has the CHAOS keyword, you can use this ability:
  Choose one of the following:
    - Your army can include at most 1 models from TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS units.
    - Your army can include at most 3 models from WAR DOG units.
  - Friendly TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS or WAR DOG units cannot be your Warlord.
  - Friendly TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS or WAR DOG units cannot be given Enhancements.

rules.name: Malefic Surge
rules.description:
During your Command phase, until the start of your next Command phase, you can use this ability:
  - Select one or more friendly CHAOS KNIGHTS units:
    - For each selected unit:
      - This unit must take a Leadership test.
      - If the triggering leadership roll was a failure, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
      - That unit is Empowered.
      - While this unit is Empowered:
        - Select one:
          - Unholy Hunger: When this unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, until the end of the phase, this unit is no longer Empowered; add 3" to this unit's Move characteristic.
          - Diabolic Power: When this unit is selected to shoot or when this unit is selected to fight, until the end of the phase, this unit is no longer Empowered; choose one of the following: this unit's weapons gain [LETHAL HITS] / this unit's weapons gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
          - Unnatural Fortitude: When an enemy unit targets this unit, until the end of the phase, this unit is no longer Empowered; choose one of the following: this unit has a 5+ invulnerable save / this unit has Feel No Pain 6+.

  - Select one friendly CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit within 9" of this model other than this unit. That unit is designated as Throne Tyrannicus.
  - Each ability of this model that affects WAR DOG units can also affect friendly units that are designated as Throne Tyrannicus.
